definitions: A disorder of the inner ear that can lead to dizzy spells (vertigo) and hearing loss.
A chronic condition affecting the vestibular and auditory systems, characterized by episodes of vertigo, tinnitus, aural fullness, and fluctuating hearing loss.
examples: She was diagnosed with Ménière's disease.
Ménière's disease can significantly impact quality of life.
Treatment options for Ménière's disease vary.
